itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo, welcome dinner
itinerary.source: You are met at Cairo International Airport, transferred to your hotel, and sit down to a welcome dinner that introduces the Egyptian table — mezze, grilled meats, flatbreads — before any of the serious work begins.

itinerary.title: Giza plateau, Grand Egyptian Museum, Khan el-Khalili
itinerary.source: The second day covers more ground than any other Cairo day.

itinerary.title: Flight to Hurghada, all-inclusive resort
itinerary.source: You arrive in Hurghada and check into your all-inclusive resort; the afternoon is yours immediately — beach, pool, a beachside dinner as the light leaves the water.

itinerary.title: First full Hurghada day: the reef
itinerary.source: The Red Sea holds one of the most biodiverse coral reef systems on earth, and the first full Hurghada day is the one to meet it.

itinerary.title: Free day with no programme
itinerary.source: The next day has no programme at all.

itinerary.title: Drive to Luxor, board Nile cruise
itinerary.source: You arrive in Luxor in the afternoon and board your S-grade Nile cruise ship, home for the next four nights.

itinerary.title: West Bank: the land of the dead
itinerary.source: The next morning the ship moors on the West Bank, and the day belongs to the land of the dead.

itinerary.title: Edfu and Kom Ombo
itinerary.source: The ship continues to Aswan overnight.

itinerary.title: Aswan: dam, obelisk, Philae, felucca
itinerary.source: The final evening aboard the cruise ship is a farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Disembark and fly Aswan to Cairo
itinerary.source: You disembark in the morning and fly north from Aswan to Cairo.

itinerary.title: Coptic and Islamic Cairo
itinerary.source: The last full day explores the Cairo beyond the pharaonic story.

itinerary.title: Transfer to the airport
itinerary.source: The morning brings a transfer to the airport; for those with a late departure, additional time can be arranged.
